name: keystroke
title: Keystroke
description: Physical keycaps rise and press to show keyboard shortcuts, one chord after another.
useWhen: A product tutorial or demo needs to show which keyboard shortcut is being used.
Keys should feel physical, rising and pressing, rather than appear as flat text.
avoidWhen: You need a flat caption: use a lower-third or text block.
The video has no keyboard action to illustrate.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Steps
variables.description: JSON array of {at, keys, hold}: at is the frame (30 fps), keys is a chord like "mod+k", "shift+mod+p", or a sequence like "g i"; mod is Command on Mac and Ctrl on Windows.

variables.label: Platform
variables.description: Keyboard legends for Mac or Windows.

variables.label: Key size
variables.description: Key size at a 720 px frame height.

variables.label: Linger
variables.description: Frames (30 fps) a shortcut stays after it is pressed.

variables.label: Center X
variables.description: Horizontal center across the frame, 0 to 1.

variables.label: Center Y
variables.description: Vertical center down the frame, 0 to 1.
